text:
linus: fyi the js SDK publish is blocked in CI, looks like a typegen -> semver mismatch
ci-bot: ❗ publish-js job failed on runner-14:
```
> Error: Uncommitted changes after codegen step
> diff --git a/packages/sdk-js/src/index.d.ts b/packages/sdk-js/src/index.d.ts
> index 123..456 100644
> --- a/packages/sdk-js/src/index.d.ts
> +++ b/packages/sdk-js/src/index.d.ts
> @@ -1,4 +1,5 @@
> +export type NewThing = { id: string }
> package.json version: 1.3.0 but changelog shows 1.2.0
> npm publish aborted: version mismatch
```
maya: ugh, not again. is this from the openapi generator change?
alex.dev: I opened #8542 that regenerated types — the generator reorder changed export ordering so typegen diff appeared. I didn't bump package.json because I thought it was non-breaking (only order).
jen: policy reminder: any change that modifies surface types (add/remove/rename or ordering that changes declaration files) needs at least a patch bump, sometimes minor if new APIs land. ordering-only diffs are murky.
linus: CI treats any file diff as a code change we must release. two choices: revert the regen PR, or update package.json + changelog and push another commit. which is faster?
alex.dev: I can update the PR with a patch bump and a changelog entry. Question: where should the changelog note live for SDKs? we have to follow the semver/changelog convention in /docs/release-guides/sdk-changelog.md right?
jen: correct — add one bullet under Unreleased -> sdk-js: patch: "regen: align types with new openapi order" and reference the generator commit. then bump to 1.3.1 and CI should allow publish.
sam.release: If we go patch route, ping me for a stamp. Also confirm sample-app parity tests pass — last time a type change broke the example app imports.
maya: sample-app parity job is flaky but we can run locally: `yarn workspace sample-app build && node dist/demo.js` — will catch missing exports.
alex.dev: running generator with stable flag now: `openapi-codegen --input openapi.yaml --stable-sort --emit-d-ts` — should normalize ordering. pushing small commit in 10.
ci-bot: re-run requested by alex.dev on publish-js pipeline (run id: 202).
ci-bot: running typegen job...
ci-bot: typegen step completed, no diffs after `--stable-sort`
ci-bot: publish-js job resumed:
```
> npm publish succeeded to registry (1.3.1)
> artifact: sdk-js-1.3.1.tgz
```
linus: nice. can we add a tiny integration test to catch ordering-only diffs next time? maybe a sort-canonicalization check in CI that compares ASTs rather than raw file diffs.
jen: good idea. filing a follow-up ticket for eng-tooling to add a canonicalize step. @sam.release can you include that in next sprint?
sam.release: noted, will add to sprint planning. thanks all. :tada:
